## Table 7 — Keyword reference: how SATD is detected & categorized

*All patterns matched case-insensitive; first match wins. Readable keyword lists below; the exact regexes are in `satd_detect.py` (`DEBT_PHRASES`, `DEFERRAL_PHRASES`, `_DEFECT`, `_HANDLE_ERROR`, `_REFACTOR`) and `graph_admissions.py` (sub-concern).*

### A. What counts as SATD

- **Strong markers** (debt on their own): `FIXME`, `HACK`, `XXX`
- **Debt phrases** (code comments; a bare `TODO` needs one of these): `hack`, `hacky`, `kludge`, `workaround`, `temporary`/`temp`, `for now`, `for the time being`, `quick fix`/`quick and dirty`, `band-aid`, `dirty fix`, `ugly`, `stupid`, `silly`, `nasty`, `messy`, `crap`, `not sure`, `don't know/understand`, `no idea`, `should refactor/fix/rewrite/clean/be removed`, `needs (to be) fixed/refactored/reworked/cleaned/revisited`, `needs work`, `get rid of`, `revisit this`, `come back to`, `this is wrong/broken/a mess/problematic`, `not (yet) implemented/supported/done/finished`, `placeholder`, `stub`, `will break`, `is broken`, `remove this`, `rewrite this`, `giving up`
- **Conversational deferral** (extra phrases for PR text/dialogue): `for now`, `follow-up`, `out of scope (for this PR)`, `will/I'll address/handle/fix/do … later`, `address … in a later/future/follow`, `didn't have time`, `skip(ping)`, `known limitation`, `leave this/it for`, `revisit later`, `come back to this`, `hardcode(d/ing)`, `left … as a follow-up`, `not in this/scope`

### B. Debt TYPE (classify_type — first match wins)

| Type | Assigned when the comment matches | Keywords |
|---|---|---|
| **bug** | a defect cue AND **not** an error-handling cue | `bug`, `buggy`, `fix this/the bug`, `fix issue`, `broken`, `crash(es/ed/ing)`, `wrong`, `incorrect`, `doesn't work`, `does not work`, `not working`, `corrupt`, `race condition`, `deadlock`, `memory leak`, `null pointer`/`npe`, `out of bounds/memory/range`, `overflow`, `underflow`, `off-by-one` |
| *(excluded from bug)* | error-handling, so routine TODOs aren't mislabelled | `handle (the) error`, `error handling` |
| **refactoring** | a behaviour-preserving reshape cue | `refactor(ing)`, `restructure`, `reorganize`, `clean up`/`cleanup`, `simplify`, `consolidate`, `decouple`, `modularize`, `extract`, `move to/into`, `split`, `duplicat*`, `copy-paste`, `DRY`, `dead code` |
| **design** | none of the above (catch-all; requirement/design debt, old "feature") | — |

### C. Sub-concern (design-debt sub-type — first match wins)

| Sub-concern | Keywords |
|---|---|
| interim / stopgap | `for now`, `temporar*`, `temp `, `quick fix`, `workaround`, `work around`, `for the time being`, `hack` |
| placeholder / stub | `placeholder`, `stub`, `dummy` |
| hardcoded / magic value | `hardcod`, `hard-cod`, `hard cod`, `magic number`, `magic value` |
| unsupported / not implemented | `not supported`, `not yet`, `nyi`, `not implemented`, `only support`, `doesn't support`, `does not support`, `unsupported`, `no support`, `not available` |
| deferred removal / revisit | `remove this`, `should be removed`, `get rid`, `eventually`, `revisit`, `once `, `when we` |
